cases.sentence: Иоаннафан велел своему молодому ___ перейти к филистимской заставе.
cases.translation: Jonathan told his young armor-bearer to go to the Philistine garrison.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case in Russian.

cases.sentence: На голове у него был бронзовый ___ в Мегроне.
cases.translation: A bronze helmet was on his head in Migron.
cases.explain: The noun шлем is the subject of the sentence and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Саул находился под гранатовым ___ в Мегроне.
cases.translation: Saul was staying under a pomegranate tree in Migron.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with the instrumental case indicates location.

cases.sentence: Возьми с собой ___ и скажи я пришел принести жертву.
cases.translation: Take a young cow with you and say I have come to offer a sacrifice.
cases.explain: The transitive verb взять (to take) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Он был сыном Ахитува, брата ___ в Вифлееме.
cases.translation: He was the son of Ahitub, brother of the priest in Bethlehem.
cases.explain: The preposition брата (brother of) is followed by the genitive case to show possession.

cases.sentence: На каждой стороне переправы стояло по скалистому ___.
cases.translation: On each side of the crossing there stood a rocky crag.
cases.explain: The preposition по with the dative case indicates distribution or relation.

cases.sentence: Иоаннафан сказал ___, давай перейдем к той заставе.
cases.translation: Jonathan said to the young one, let us go to that garrison.
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) with the preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда ужас охватил все филистимское ___ в лагере.
cases.translation: Then terror seized all the Philistine army in the camp.
cases.explain: The noun войско is the direct object of the transitive verb охватил (seized) so it stands in the accusative case.

reading.ru: В один из дней Иоаннафан, сын Саула, велел своему молодому оруженосцу, «Давай перейдем к ферестимской заставе на другую сторону реки».
reading.question: What did Jonathan propose to his armor-bearer?
options: To attack the Philistine garrison across the river
reading.correct: To attack the Philistine garrison across the river
reading.explain: Jonathan suggested crossing the river to the Philistine garrison, as stated in the opening of the chapter.

reading.ru: Саул находился на окраине Гивы, под гранатовым деревом в Мегроне.
reading.question: Where was Saul staying when Jonathan and his armor-bearer went out?
options: On the edge of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree
reading.correct: On the edge of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that Saul was at the edge of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан сказал своему молодому оруженосцу. «Давай перейдем к заставе этих необрезанных. Может быть, Господь будет действовать нам во благо?»
reading.question: What did Jonathan believe God might do for them?
reading.explain: Jonathan said 'Может быть, Господь будет действовать нам во благо?' which means 'Perhaps the Lord will work for us (to our benefit).'

reading.ru: Во время первого нападения Иоаннафан и его оруженосец убили около 20 человек на месте размером с половину поля, обрабатываемого парой валов за один день.
reading.question: How many people did Jonathan and his armor-bearer kill in their first attack?
reading.explain: The text states 'убили около 20 человек' — they killed about twenty men.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан не слышал, как его отец связал народ клятвой и, протянув посох, который был у него в руке, обмакнул его в соты.
reading.question: What did Jonathan do with his staff when he did not hear his father's oath?
options: He dipped it in the honeycomb
He used it as a weapon
He planted it in the ground
reading.correct: He dipped it in the honeycomb
reading.explain: Jonathan, unaware of Saul's oath, dipped the end of his staff in the honeycomb, as the text states.

reading.ru: Народ сказал Саулу, Иоаннафану ли умереть, тому, кто принес Израилю великое избавление?
reading.question: How did the people respond to Saul's death sentence on Jonathan?
options: They defended Jonathan and refused to let him die
reading.correct: They defended Jonathan and refused to let him die
reading.explain: The people argued that Jonathan should not die because he had brought about a great deliverance for Israel.
